header: Test vectors for decoding ML-DSA-65 SubjectPublicKeyInfo encodings.
Vectors exercise malformed and edge-case DER inputs; consumers should
verify their SPKI parser accepts/rejects each encoding per the

InvalidAlgorithmIdentifier.description: The AlgorithmIdentifier is malformed for the key type: typically its parameters field is present when the algorithm forbids any parameters.

InvalidBitString.description: The SubjectPublicKey BIT STRING is malformed at the BIT STRING layer: the unused-bits header byte is non-zero or larger than 7, the BIT STRING contents are empty, the BIT STRING tag is substituted with another tag (e.g. OCTET STRING), or the BIT STRING uses indefinite length.

InvalidKeySize.description: The encoded public-key material has the wrong byte length for the declared algorithm or parameter set (truncated or extended).

InvalidLengthEncoding.description: The encoding uses a length octet form that is not the shortest valid DER form, or declares a length that does not match the body (non-minimal long form, BER indefinite length, over- or under-declared length). Strict DER parsers should reject; BER-tolerant parsers may accept.

InvalidStructure.description: The outer or inner SEQUENCE shape is malformed: a required field is missing, the fields are reordered, an extra trailing field is present, the outer container has the wrong tag (e.g. SET instead of SEQUENCE), or an inner field is tagged incorrectly.

Normal.description: Well-formed encoding included as a sanity check that the corpus's positive path is accepted.

TrailingData.description: The encoding consists of a well-formed structure followed by extra bytes after the outer SEQUENCE. Parsers should reject any input with trailing data.

WrongAlgorithm.description: The AlgorithmIdentifier.algorithm OID identifies a different algorithm than the key bytes. Parsers should validate that the OID matches the key material before deriving a key.

tests.comment: well-formed ML-DSA-65 SubjectPublicKeyInfo
AlgorithmIdentifier.parameters is NULL; ML-DSA forbids any parameters
public-key BIT STRING is truncated by one byte
public-key BIT STRING has one extra trailing byte
public-key BIT STRING has non-zero unused-bits header (0x04)
outer SEQUENCE length encoded in non-minimal 1-octet long form, truncating the high byte of the declared length
outer SEQUENCE uses BER indefinite length (0x80 ... 00 00); illegal DER
outer SEQUENCE declared length is one byte too large; reads past end
outer SEQUENCE declared length is one byte too small; truncates last body byte
well-formed encoding followed by a trailing 0x00 byte
AlgorithmIdentifier.algorithm is a sibling ML-DSA OID; public-key bytes are the wrong size for that parameter set
AlgorithmIdentifier.algorithm is the Ed25519 OID; ML-DSA public-key bytes are far too large for an Ed25519 key (32 bytes)
outer SEQUENCE is empty (zero fields)
outer container is tagged as SET (0x31) instead of SEQUENCE (0x30)
AlgorithmIdentifier field is missing
subjectPublicKey BIT STRING field is missing
fields are reordered: subjectPublicKey before AlgorithmIdentifier
AlgorithmIdentifier SEQUENCE is tagged as SET (0x31)
extra trailing field (NULL) inside the outer SEQUENCE after subjectPublicKey
public-key BIT STRING unused-bits header is 0x08 (illegal; max is 7)
public-key BIT STRING is empty (no unused-bits header byte at all)
public-key field tag is OCTET STRING (0x04) instead of BIT STRING (0x03)
public-key BIT STRING uses BER indefinite length (illegal DER)
outer SEQUENCE length encoded in non-minimal 3-octet long form (0x83 0x00 hh ll)
outer SEQUENCE length octet is the reserved 0xff value
outer SEQUENCE declares a 4-octet length of 0xffffffff, far larger than the body
AlgorithmIdentifier.parameters uses context-specific tag class ([0] IMPLICIT NULL)
AlgorithmIdentifier.algorithm OID has non-minimal base-128 sub-identifier encoding
